title: True Blue Account: Fee Waivers and Balance Requirements
summary: This document explains the True Blue Account monthly maintenance fee ($75) and how it’s waived when your balance is at least $50,000 during the statement period. It also covers the $25,000 minimum balance for premium features, $25 overdraft fee when your balance goes negative, and True Blue Referral Program rewards ($350 referrer bonus, $250 new member bonus, max 15 referrals/year) with $50,000 deposits due within 120 days and a 90-day account age requirement.
faqs: How do I waive the True Blue monthly maintenance fee, and what is the threshold?
What is the minimum balance required to maintain the True Blue account and access premium features?
What happens if my True Blue account balance goes negative (overdraft/shortfall fees)?
If I fall below $25,000, will I lose premium features until my balance is restored?
What are the True Blue Referral Program bonuses and limits (including max referrals per year)?
What are the referral qualifications for the referred business (deposit amount, time window, and account age requirement)?
keywords: Deposit window: 120 days / Account age requirement: 90 days
